Whether you are traveling for business, vacation or family, Dubai’s charm will make you want to stay longer. Fortunately, we offer a variety of visa extension UAE options to meet the needs and circumstances of different visitors. 

In this article, you will learn about the visa extension UAE process, the different types of visas available and the required documents.

The Application Process: Visa Extension in UAE

Here are some of the reasons to renew your UAE visa: 

  • The UAE’s neighbors are Oman and Saudi Arabia, and they share maritime borders with countries such as Qatar, the Persian Gulf and Iran. 
  • Everyone knows that the UAE’s oil and natural gas reserves are the sixth and seventh largest in the world, respectively, and the oil refinery is a famous attraction that people around the world want to visit at least once in their lives. 
  • Most tourists visit Dubai to see the tallest building, the Burj Khalifa, take part in Diwali celebrations and enjoy exotic dinners on camel rides and desert safaris. You can also enjoy a dune cruise and a spectacular banquet accompanied by a live show of Arabic traditions. 
  • Dubai is a global business center and a very modern city, and the designer skyscrapers on the skyline make this place even more attractive. Influenced by Western culture, today’s youth love fast food. Young people visiting or residing in the UAE also enjoy fast food. 
  • Since the country does not have an oil problem, it focuses mainly on tourism and business. Yes, you need a visa before departure. Wherever you go, you must have a notarized visa. UAE Visa Online helps you apply and process your UAE e-visa online.

Step-by-Step Guide to Completing Your Application

The new UAE residency visa extension UAE rules have been officially announced, allowing individuals to easily extend or cancel their entry permit through their personal online account. If you’re planning to cancel your visa, you may be required to submit a Dubai visa cancellation letter as part of the process. The processing of a UAE visa cancellation usually takes 48 hours.

The new rules stipulate that travelers can extend their 30- and 60 days visa extension UAE in the country for an additional 30 days. The maximum number of days you can stay in the country per year is 120 days. 

It is not possible to extend the visa after this period. You can also extend your visa on arrival in Dubai without leaving the UAE. An additional 90-day extension is available for travelers with a UAE visa. 

All categories of tourist visas can now be extended for a further 30 days. The UAE tourist visa extension UAE fee is approximately AED 1,100.

If you select the passport or travel document option, be sure to enter the passport or travel document information used to issue your visa. 

  • Select a unique number. Please enter your passport/document number. 
  • Select Passport/Document 
  • Type: Select the document type. Different types of documents are available. 
  • Enter date of birth: Enter your date of birth as it appears on your passport. 
  • Enter your current nationality: Enter your current nationality as shown on your passport.
  • Then click the “Search” button to view your visa information.

Required Documents and Necessary Preparations

You must have at least two-color scanned copies of the first and last pages of your passport. 

Make sure that your passport has 6 months left before its expiry date and that your visa cannot be extended. The most efficient way to apply for a Dubai Visa extension UAE is online: 

To extend your Dubai visa, go to Dubai Visit Visa online and look for “Visit Visa Extension” on the screen. 

  • Available at the top of the page. 
  • A form will appear on the right side of the screen. 
  • Fill out the application form. 
  • Make sure you have entered all required documents and information correctly. 
  • Enter your current citizenship: Enter your current citizenship in your passport. 
  • Then click the “Search” button to check your visa information.

Fees and Payment Options

How much is visa extension in UAE? Dubai Visa Renewal Fee: The Dubai Tourist Visa renewal fee is AED 1,100. This includes an application fee of AED 100 and an ongoing fee of AED 1,000. 

Talking about the types of visit visa extension UAE, there are two types: 

  • 30 days extension
  • 90-day visa extension UAE

30 days extension in Dubai

  • It is available for tourists and travelers for one month. There are several options and Visa extension UAE price. You can request two consecutive 30-day extensions, and each extension can be filed locally, so you do not need to leave the country. 
  • If you wish to extend your stay, you can apply for another extension before your original visa expires. Each extension costs $470. This flexible system allows tourists and travelers to enjoy longer stays without the hassle of leaving Dubai. 
  • Then, resubmit your application. As mentioned above, people who overstay their visa and do not renew it will have to pay a portion of the fine for each day they overstay. The overstay fine in UAE must be paid in full 10 days after the visa expires.

90-day extension for Dubai

  • You can apply for an extension of your visa for Dubai (single segment visa) by three months in your own country. Once approved by the relevant authorities, you do not need to leave the country and the application is valid for 90 days from the date of issue. 
  • If you wish to extend your visa, you can apply for a second visa before your initial visa expires (at a cost of $570 per visa). However, if your visa is not renewed, you will be charged an overstay penalty in UAE – one day’s fee for each day beginning 10 days after its expiration.

Choosing the Right Application Method (Online vs. Offline)

  1. Check your eligibility. Before you start the application process, you need to check if you are eligible for a tourist visa extension UAE. Have a valid passport with at least 6 months remaining on the initial in country visa extension UAE and a confirmed return. 
  2. Document preparation. Completed visa extension application form. Copies of important detail pages of your passport and current UAE visa page. A copy of your confirmed return ticket or outbound ticket. A recent passport photo’s. Proof of sufficient funds
  3. Visit the Dubai Visa Services online portal. Select the appropriate passport or travel document option and ensure the details match the document used on the original visa. Please enter your jersey number and passport number and select the type of document you have. 
  • Enter your date of birth and current nationality as indicated on your passport. 
  • Click on the “Search” button for visa information. 
  • Upload your prepared documents and complete your contact details in the online form. 
  1. Payment of fees. Renewal fees vary depending on the extension length (for example, $136 for 30 days and $272 for 60 days). You pay this fee online using your credit or debit card. Processing Time Processing takes 3-5 business days, which may vary during busy periods. 

Recovering your visa once your visa status has been processed, you can recover your extended visa. We will inform you separately about the collection method. This can be done at a visa application center or a local post office.

Offline Method

  • Visit the Department of Residence and Immigration. Find and visit the nearest Residence Management Bureau. 
  • Submit documents: Please provide the same set of documents as listed in the online process. 
  • Payment fees: Pay the applicable renewal fees to the service center. 4. Processing and Collection:

Once submitted, the processing time is the same as online. After your visa change or extension is approved, you will need to follow the GDRFA staff’s instructions to obtain your passport and new visa. 

By following these steps, you can easily extend your visa to visit Dubai, ensure you meet UAE entry requirements, and enjoy a longer stay in this dynamic city.

Medical Test Requirements (if applicable)

  • In the face of global crises such as the pandemic, the UAE government has demonstrated adaptability in its visa policies. Individuals whose residency visas expired during the COVID-19 pandemic were automatically extended to provide them with relief, enabling them to stay in the country despite travel restrictions preventing them from leaving or renewing their visas. 
  • In addition, individuals whose residency permits were revoked after March 1 have 30 days to find a new job, arrange sponsorship, or prepare to leave the UAE.

Different Visa Types: UAE Visa Extension

There are many benefits to extending your Dubai visa. Most importantly, it allows you to extend your stay in this vibrant city, giving you more time to explore its famous landmarks, enjoy its diverse cuisine and experience its rich culture. 

The extension ensures uninterrupted work obligations for work visa holders and eliminates the need to reapply. Families can spend more time together and tourists can make the most of special occasions. 

Visa extensions UAE also provide peace of mind by ensuring compliance with local regulations. Overall, extending your visa in Dubai gives you flexibility, convenience and a more comfortable stay in this thriving metropolis.

Tourist Visa Extensions 

Foreign citizens can apply for this visa if they have a family member or friend who is a citizen/resident of the United Arab Emirates. This visa also does not require a sponsor/host. Approximately AED 1100 is the cost for renewing a visitor visa in the UAE, but it can vary depending on the visa fee in Dubai.

Employment Visa Extensions 

  • This is an important step by the UAE government to encourage applicants and expedite the process. This visa does not require a sponsor or host, but applicants must have at least a bachelor’s degree or equivalent from one of the world’s top 500 universities. 
  • According to the UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Development. Second class and skill level.

Retirement Visa Extensions 

  • If you are a visitor to Dubai and wish to convert your visit visa to another category due to reasons like termination of employment, you will need to apply for a visa conversion ticket or tourist visa to extend your stay for up to 90-day visa extension UAE. 
  • This is a viable option without the risk of sanctions. The conversion process incurs national fees and requires the presentation of several documents, including a copy of your passport, a photo, and a medical certificate if you are over 18 years old.

Dependent Visa Extensions 

  • Foreigners living in Dubai with a valid residency permit can sponsor a family member if they meet the minimum salary requirement of $1,090 or $817 per stay. Under certain conditions, spouses, children and parents may also be eligible. 
  • Family members can sponsor males up to the age of 25, and they can sponsor single women regardless of age. In some cases, the mother may sponsor the child and the resident parent may sponsor the child.

How Royal Visa Support Can Assist You with UAE Visa Extension

  • With the introduction of the online system, visa renewal has become easier. Now you can easily manage the expiration dates of your visa and entry permits through your personal online account, simplifying the process of renewing or canceling your visa. 
  • This digital approach is part of the UAE’s new entry and residency system, which aims to make the country an attractive base for various activities. The big change is that travelers now have to leave Dubai to renew their tourist visas. 
  • The United Arab Emirates has suspended the possibility of visa renewal for domestic visitors. This can be done via airport-to-airport (A2A) services. 
  • This service requires the tourist to leave the country for one day before reapplying for a visa. If you have a 90-day visitor visa, you can extend it for another 90 day visa extension UAE.

Conclusion

In short, Dubai visa extension UAE options, for both 90 and 30 days, offer visitors a valuable opportunity to get a stay suited to their needs. 

While costs may vary depending on the type and duration of the extension, the benefits of extending your visa to visit Dubai are significant. 

These extensions allow you to explore the city, conduct business, and have fun with family and friends at your own pace. It also ensures compliance with local regulations and avoids fines for overstaying. Contact us to know more.

FAQs

Can a UAE Visa Be Extended?

Yes, most UAE visas can be extended for 30 to 90 days, depending on the visa type and current immigration rules.

What Is the Cost of A Visa Extension in The UAE?

Visa extension costs typically range between AED 600 and AED 1,000, depending on the duration and processing service selected.

What Are the Minimum Eligibility Requirements for A Visa Extension?

You must hold a valid visa, apply before expiry, and provide supporting documents such as passport and visa copies. Fines apply for overstaying.

Can I Extend My Visa After Cancellation in The UAE?

Yes, in many cases you can apply for a tourist or visit visa after residency cancellation. This allows continued stay without exiting.

Can I Do a Visa Extension Online in UAE?

Yes, most extensions can be applied for online through the ICA or GDRFA portals. Approval timelines depend on the service type chosen.

What Is the Process of Visa Extension in UAE?

Submit your application online or through an authorized typing center with passport, visa copy, and payment. Your visa status will be updated once everything gets approved.
